The '''Republic military base''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] complex of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were held captive here after the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]], the latter for the death of the former. At that time [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], and a tactical droid were also held captive in the base. It was located in close proximity to the [[Coruscant shipyard/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer staging areas]].

Inside the base, there was the [[First Battle Memorial/Legends|First Battle Memorial]], a large slab of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosian]] rock that showed the names of all the clones who fell in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]].

==Characteristics==
===Interior===
Each hallway was either lined with a series of [[Ray shield/Legends|double ray shielded segments]] or contained a series of [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]].<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

This section had an area that was very comparable to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]]. The cells had two options for entering. The first was sliding a keycard. The second was pressing a button on the outside of each cell. The cells had [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] doors to make sure prisoners did not escape. Inside the cells there was a bed and bowls for water and food.<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

Another area in the prison was a medium circle room with a fairly large [[Computer/Legends|computer]] for scanning people before they entered the base, a crate for weapons and communication devices, and a red button to start the red alert sequence.<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

===Exterior===
[[File:RepublicMilitaryBaseCourtyard-TWJ.png|thumb|left|254x254px|The base courtyard containing the First Battle Memorial.]]
The main building was stationed with rapid repeating heavy turbo laser turrets and a series of deflector shields with two large projectors located right on the building.<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

The [[First Battle Memorial/Legends|First Battle Memorial]] was built in the center of the Republic base's plaza, its purpose to honor the clone troopers that were killed in the Battle of Geonosis. Around this area are obelisks that have giant carvings of clone troopers on each side as well as flags bearing the colors in galactic roundel that signified the Republic.<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

===Airfield===
Outside of the prison there was an airfield with [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernauts]], and other ships with a refueling depot. When [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] escaped the prison in the facility, she went out onto the airfield with hopes of escaping the compound. It was normal to see [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] squads patrolling the base while walking on the airfield. The First Battle Memorial was also located here.<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

===Military Tribunal Courtroom===
Inside of the compound there was a military tribunal courtroom of which the court decided on the fate of dangerous criminals. It was a tall room, with platforms extending into its center for the accused, prosecution, and defense. There was seating along its walls for the presiding official, jury, and other trial participants and onlookers.<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

==History==
{{Main|Escape from the Republic military base/Legends}}
{{Main|Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends}}
[[File:RepublicMiliaryCourtroom-TWJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano stands trial in the base courtroom]]
[[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] was transferred to the base, because the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing at the Jedi Temple]] had become a military matter. [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Admiral Tarkin]] reported that Letta had requested [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] presence. At the base she was set up by an unseen person, who killed the prisoner and helped Ahsoka escape, making her look even more guilty in the process. [[Fox/Legends|Commander Fox]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]], [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF trooper]] "[[Hound/Legends|Hound]]," his [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] [[Grizzer (massiff)/Legends|Grizzer]], and other clones, hunted her down as she escaped from the facility.<ref name="Knew Too Much" />

After Tano was recaptured, and with suspicions on her made even worse after being found near a canister of nanobots, she was then put on trial at the military base's tribunal courtroom. Her verdict was about to be read when Skywalker had arrived with Barriss Offee and had her confess to actually being responsible.<ref name="TWJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base's design was meant to foreshadow the rise of the Galactic Empire. To support this, in the episode "[[The Jedi Who Knew Too Much]]" the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] slowly stop taking orders from the Jedi. For instance, when Anakin was trying to get into the prison to see his Padawan, Commander Fox wouldn't let him in under Tarkin's orders.<ref name="TWJ" />

The base's courtroom, likewise, was also intended to emphasize the rise of the Galactic Empire. The production notes also indicated that the cylindrical tubes hanging from the ceiling were intended to invoke similar terminals seen on the Death Star. The terminals themselves, however, were reused from the engine rooms of the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep520|text="The Wrong Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
